_howTo: Default services shown in the dashboard. The real prices live in the Firestore 'services' collection and are edited on the admin page (admin → Services). Use 'Load default services' there once to copy this file in. A price of null shows 'Price coming soon' and can't be bought. Prices are in euros, e.g. 49 or 49.5.
